author: Evan Denton
title: Iowa women's basketball reflects on tough west coast trip - NewsBreak
text:
By Evan Denton ,
1 hours ago
The Iowa women’s basketball team is facing a little bit of adversity.
The Hawkeyes went 0-2 on their west coast road trip against USC and UCLA. While the Hawkeyes are 18-4 overall, players and head coach Jan Jensen said the west coast trip showed them areas of the game that need improvement.
“We’re just focusing on what we need to,” said Journey Houston, an Iowa freshman guard. “We had a lot of (unforced turnovers against) ULCA, so we just got to fix those little things and we’ll be alright. I think we’re all just using it as motivation to continue to get better and focus on our flaws.”
“Even looking back at the film from these past couple of games, a lot of it was on our end and wasn’t necessarily on the other team’s end, so that’s really positive because that means that we can control it,” said Kylie Feuerbach, an Iowa graduate student guard. “So just bringing things that we can control into other games, and in a better way.”
“What I’ve been constantly trying to tell them is stay the course. Stay the course. We’ve shown some really great minutes against some really great teams, (such as) Ohio State, Michigan State, at a Maryland,” Jensen said. “We’ve just had moments, even how we handled moments way back in Baylor. It’s like we’ve handled different situations. It’s now we just got to, we got to lean on that preparation.”
